title: ROV, camera and lights fail at the object

tellings.quote: >> Yep. And when we have dive on it, the camera stops working, the light stops working.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter, says his team found a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland in 2011, known as the Baltic Sea anomaly. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that whenever they dive on it, the camera and the lights stop working, including on their remote-controlled underwater robot. That would suggest the object itself interferes with equipment.
